title: Finch Circle Points Ledger Standard — Forfeiture for Inactivity and on Closure
content:
**Last activity date.** For a Finch Circle Loyalty Program membership, the last activity date is the latest of the posting date of any points earned (purchase points, bonus event, card bonus, card outside-spend, tier bonus or enrollment bonus entries) or missing-points credit entry, and the date of any note redemption, across the whole history of the membership; it is the enrolled date when there is none.

**Inactivity forfeiture.** When the last activity date is the tier's inactivity expiry months — full calendar months — or more before the handling date (read for the tier held on that date), a positive points balance is forfeited in full, for the reason "inactivity"; a zero or negative balance is left as it is.

**What counts as activity.** Earning points or redeeming a note is activity; a points deduction for a return, a note issue or a tier change is not.

**Closure.** When the membership closes, a positive balance is forfeited on the closed date, for the reason "membership closed".

**No restoration.** Forfeited points are never restored.

The inactivity expiry months of each tier are those of the points expiry and return terms.

## Cases (hypothetical; tier held on the handling date has 12 months)

| Last activity | Months before the handling date | Balance | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| a note redemption | exactly 12 full calendar months | 640 points | 640 points forfeited, reason inactivity |
| a purchase points entry | 11 full calendar months | 640 points | nothing forfeited |
| a points earning entry | 14 full calendar months | minus 90 points | left as it is |
| no activity since enrollment | 12 full calendar months after the enrolled date | 500 points | 500 points forfeited |

## Points of judgement

- A return deduction posted last month does not restart the clock; neither does a new note or a tier change.
- Points forfeited for inactivity do not come back when the member shops again.
